annotation.title_clean: § 21a Verfahren und zuständige Behörden in der Betriebskategorie „offen“ nach der Durchführungsverordnung (EU) 2019/947 (Luftverkehrs-Ordnung)
annotation.title_en: Section 21a Procedure and competent authorities in the 'open' operating category under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 (German Air Traffic Order)
named_instruments_referenced: EU Implementing Regulation 2019/947 on UAS operations
annotation.summary_en: Section 21a of the German Air Traffic Order implements EU Implementing Regulation 2019/947 for the 'open' drone category. It names the Federal Aviation Office as the authority that examines and certifies remote pilots, gives oversight to state aviation authorities, and allows certificates to be issued fully automatically, with a right to have a human official decide.
key_provisions_or_claims: The Luftfahrt-Bundesamt is the competent authority for examining and certifying remote-pilot competence in the open category.
Exam candidates must show a valid ID; minors also need consent from a legal guardian.
State aviation authorities supervise open-category drone operations.
Pilot competence certificates and fee notices may be issued fully by automated means.
Remote pilots have the right to state their position and to a decision by a human official.
